summary.text: Charniele Herring is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates for District 4, representing part of Fairfax County and part of the city of Alexandria, serving since January 26, 2009. The House's member profile lists committee assignments including Rules (vice chair), Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources, and Health and Human Services.

paragraphs.text: Charniele L. Herring was born in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic, according to the House's member profile.
The profile says she earned a B.A. in economics from George Mason University in 1993 and lists her occupation as attorney.
The profile lists her as House Majority Leader and as a member of Alexandria Rotary and a trustee of Hopkins House.
It shows her chairing the Standards of Conduct Subcommittee of Rules and the Chesapeake Subcommittee.
